insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 22/46 games (48%): 5 picks (3-2) and 17 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Pantheon against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Pantheon against them in 25/46 games (54%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Azir? They go Syndra
insights.text: Azir is a G1 favorite (7/24 G1s, played by Humanoid). In the 14 later games where it was burned or banned, Humanoid went to Syndra (3/14) and Annie (2/14).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: G1 first pick: Azir
insights.text: With first pick in Game 1 they took Azir 4/11 times (36%). Overall 5-3 on it. Ban it or be ready to answer it in G1.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Signature pick: Aatrox
insights.text: They pick Aatrox in 10/46 games (22%), 2.35x the league rate of 9%. Record 9-1.
